items.headline: Joe Burrow's 4-TD night puts QB in company of Tom Brady, Peyton Manning
items.description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions Sunday night, becoming just the third player in NFL history after Tom Brady and Peyton Manning to throw at least 20 passing touchdowns in a five-game span.
